title: License: subscription
summary: Northside DJ School's Pro license as a state of licenses.detail, on Status: the past-due health line under the tabs, the Subscription card first (facts beside History), the Limits table with a per-row Override, the stalest device first in Devices, and Duration then Recent in the rail.
compare: The record is licenses.detail's frame (LX-14, LX-41): the title is the license's name with a 'Past due' pill; under it the holder state ('In an account'), 'Priya Raman · priya@example.com' and the license id with Copy; the header's actions are the Tier: Pro ▾ control (opens Change tier), Add key (in ⋯ on phone) and ⋯. Tabs: Status, Entitlements, Keys, Devices, Activity; it opens on Status.

The health line (UX-07) sits under the tabs: one warning callout, 'Grace ends Oct 14', then one line each: 'Then it keeps DJDL 4.2.0.' and 'Renew once Northside’s invoice is paid.', with Renew…. It renders nothing on a healthy license. The past-due state is said by the pill and the callout title only.

The Subscription card is the first main card and the one place subscriptions show, for every source (Manual, External billing, App Store, Google Play, Polaris Key). On a card at least 720px wide the facts sit left as a two-column list (Current period on its own row, kept whole; Source 'Manual'; Period 'Yearly'; Grace '7 days' with 'Set in Settings'), History right, a hairline between; narrower they stack. There is no Status fact (the pill carries it) and no Started fact (History records it).

History lists only what happened, newest first, with who did it and the renewal's note: 'Renewed to Oct 7, 2026 by Alex Lindqvist' (Invoice INV-2025-0388, paid by bank transfer), 'Started by Alex Lindqvist'.

The card's ⋯ holds Renew… (Manual and External billing sources, so a healthy license can renew early) and 'Cancel subscription…'. Cancel takes an L1 confirm: 'Runs until Oct 7, 2026, then keeps DJDL 4.2.0'. Store sources never show Renew….

Limits is licenses.detail's table (LX-32, LX-33), resolved license > tier > platform default, with Preview at a date… in its head: each row's value and where it comes from ('Pro'), with Override. Only an exception carries a tag: Devices 10 'Set here', 'Pro gives 5', with Use Pro’s. Fingerprint mode from 'Pro' with Open tier → instead of Override. One verb for license overrides on every tab: Override.

Devices uses licenses.detail's rows: the seat meter (7 of 10) and Add seats… (comps a seat pack, LX-14, UX-24) in the head; the stalest device first with the warm warning tint and edge, 'Not seen for 23 days' in the warning colour on its own line over 'macOS 15 · DJDL 4.2.0', and Deauthorize…; the others with their last check-in and ⋯; Show all devices.
The rail (first below 1280, as in licenses.detail) holds Duration ('Renewing, keeps the last version · from Pro', with Change) and then Recent.
Phone: the rail's cards come first, then Subscription (facts over History), Limits (each limit a block), Devices; the tabs scroll with the cut-off tab faded; nothing scrolls sideways.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
B17: the Release tracks limit is release; Open Activity is core; the rest, Subscription included, is license.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fix, then pass: the fifth tab now visibly scrolls on phone, the stale device says why it's highlighted, and Add seats… and History are in place.

findings.issue: On phone the fifth tab (Activity) is pushed off the right edge with no hint that the tab bar scrolls (kit .tabs hides its scrollbar).
findings.resolution: Kit fix in kit/mockup.css: .tabs uses a 16 px gap below 640 px and has a sticky end cap (.tabs::after). The cap sits in the free space when the tabs fit, and when they overflow it sticks to the right edge and fades the cut-off tab. It is static CSS, not a scroll-driven animation, because shoot.mjs freezes animations and the screenshot has to show it. Checked at 390 px: Status, Entitlements, Keys and Devices fit, and Activity fades at the edge, so the bar reads as scrollable. Tabs on a card take the card's surface (--mk-tabs-bg).

findings.issue: Light warning-subtle (#eae7e6) reads grey, so warnings look disabled or selected; the stale device row has no word for why; the history has no heading; the id chip uses a key icon.
findings.resolution: On the screen: the stale device row gets a 3 px warning bar and 'Not seen for 23 days' in warning text with a clock icon. The renewals have a 'History' label. The id chip uses the id-card icon (the kit has no hash icon). Declined to change the token: --pk-warning-subtle is generated into the kit from packages/brand/css/tokens.css (build-kit.mjs owns that block), so editing it in the kit would be overwritten and would make mockups disagree with the console. Warming the light value is a brand change for the lead.

findings.issue: Phone order (Subscription, Duration, Devices) contradicts the compare; the seat meter has no Add seats… (LX-14 absorbs UX-24); 'Renewed here or with the admin API' wraps awkwardly.
findings.resolution: Removed the phone reordering, so the cards stack in source order: Subscription, Devices, Duration and limits, Recent, as the compare says. Added Add seats… beside the seat meter. The Source hint is now 'Renewed here or by API'.

findings.issue: The license Status tab was drawn twice (LX-14, LX-41) with incompatible patterns; LX-14 and LX-29 call for a per-field Override, which the single Edit button contradicted. The kv value 'Renewing, keeps the last version' wrapped and dropped its source tag to a third line, the subtitle restated the title, and 'Preview at a date…' took a full-width slot on phone.
findings.resolution: Redrawn as a state of licenses.detail: the Tier: Pro ▾ control, Add key and ⋯ in the header; the health callout under the tabs; Subscription as the first main card; licenses.detail's Limits table with a per-row Override and Preview at a date… in its head, replacing the 'Duration and limits' card, its Edit button, its subtitle and the 'Pro' tag on every row (only the exception carries 'Set here'); a Duration card ('Renewing, keeps the last version · from Pro', with Change) then Recent in the rail; Devices in licenses.detail's row style. The screen opts into the lead's new kit defaults with .kit-next on its console root (in-sentence links underlined, the warm light warning tint, 44px phone targets, the one-row phone save bar, two-up sheet feet, the white light-theme switch knob, the segmented ring, aligned On/Off, status words at the cell size).
raisedBy: reviewer #1 (kv source wrap, Edit vs Override)

findings.issue: At wide History used 300px of a 1,183px card; at tablet the facts grid broke 'Oct 7, 2025 – / Oct 7, 2026'; Started appeared twice.
findings.resolution: Facts and History share the card from 720px of card width (.card-split.stack-md), stacking below; Started is gone; the current period is one unbroken fact on its own row; sentence sub-lines ('Renewed here or by API', 'Set in Settings') are 13/20.

findings.issue: The pill, the callout title and a History row said 'past due' three times; a healthy Manual subscription had no way to renew; Cancel had no confirm.
findings.resolution: Callout title 'Grace ends Oct 14', body 'Then it keeps DJDL 4.2.0. Renew once Northside’s invoice is paid.'; History drops 'Renewal due, not recorded'; the Subscription ⋯ carries Renew… and 'Cancel subscription…' (L1 confirm 'Runs until Oct 7, 2026, then keeps DJDL 4.2.0'); Override is the one verb for license overrides.

findings.issue: The compare asked for repetition the better render had already dropped, so a builder reviewed against it would add it back.
findings.resolution: Compare updated to the render: Versions is set once, in Duration (not in Limits); the Subscription panel has no Status fact (the pill carries it); new-major drops the tier-order subtitle and follows licenses.list's pager and h1; the catalog's 'applied in order' foot lives in the Kinds legend; LX-43's 'free' preset is the Lifetime preset on a tier with no offer, so there are six presets.

findings.issue: Builders would copy ARIA that axe flags: switches named 'On', presets and filters as role=tablist with no tabs, an unnamed breadcrumb nav, glyph-only kind icons.
findings.resolution: Switches are <button class="switch" role="switch" aria-checked aria-labelledby="<row title>">; presets, the Versions and When it ends groups, the kind and ledger filters and the holder control are role=radiogroup with role=radio items; crumbs are <nav class="crumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb">; a glyph that stands alone (a kind icon on phone, a feature glyph) is role=img with an aria-label, and decorative glyphs and avatar initials are aria-hidden. axe-core 4.13 reports 0 violations on all 12 screens, both themes, at 1440 and 390.

findings.issue: Right-align Recent rows' dates at every screen width of 640px and up.
findings.resolution: declined: The kit decides by card width, not screen width: a narrow card drops the time under the text. Moving Recent holders into the wide main column at desktop gives the right-aligned dates anyway.

findings.issue: Put an outline Renew… button in the Subscription card head.
findings.resolution: declined: On a past-due license the health line already shows Renew…, so two would duplicate. The accepted change puts Renew… in the card's ⋯ menu for healthy licenses.

findings.issue: Draw the missing states and flows now: catalog-states, addons-empty, addon-states, save failed, the read-only viewer, the edit drawer and file confirmation, New add-on, the Remove and Change-to-units confirms, the Override editor, Comp flows, Create codes, the Preview at a date result, the canceled subscription and the move-major confirm.
findings.resolution: declined: The owner scoped this pass to spacing and kept the content, so new screens are logged for the area's next states round, not drawn now. The behaviour they need is already in the accepted compare items. After convergence, Override, Comp an add-on and Preview at a date belong to licenses.detail. Create codes belongs to commerce. The read-only state is a cross-area RBAC kit pattern. The ledger's empty and error states follow ADMIN.md T2's generic table states.

findings.issue: The past-due state was said three times, 'Pro' repeated in four rows, one-line cards wasted space and the Open Activity link was out of the shared slot.
findings.resolution: Banner: 'Grace ends Oct 14, then it keeps DJDL 4.2.0' with 'Renew once Northside's invoice is paid.' and one settings link. The Grace and Source helpers are removed (the Grace cell is dropped because the license is past due; it would stay as one row when it is not). Limits subtitle is 'Values from Pro; overrides marked'; the From column shows an Override tag only for overrides and a dash otherwise. Duration is the first row of the Subscription card. 'Open Activity →' is a ghost action in the Recent header's right slot (.card-head.ghost-action).

findings.issue: The reading order flipped at tablet and the right column ended at y=830 while the left ran to 1460.
findings.resolution: Subscription is first at every size (the old rail-first order is removed); Recent follows Devices below 1280 and is a sticky rail from 1280 (.mk-with-rail.sticky-rail); the content is capped at 1280 (.page.form-page).

findings.issue: Remove the Grace cell from Subscription entirely (ux4), versus keep it (ux3 keeps the banner link).
findings.resolution: declined: conflict resolved: keep the Grace row as a single fact only when the license is not past due; when past due, the banner carries it. The 'Set in Settings' helper is dropped either way.

findings.issue: Row-level buttons, overflow menus and copy icons were 24px or less on phone, and bare text links had no hit area.
findings.resolution: The kit's .kit-next rules already give icon buttons in rows a 40px target (the copy icon is one); standalone links take .link.tap (44px on phone, padding not glyph); the header tooltip glyph is a 40px target on phone.

findings.issue: Gaps of 24, 32 and 48px and meta type of 12/20 against 13/22 drifted between screens.
findings.resolution: Under .ent2: 32px section gap, card head 56px (72px with a subtitle), meta type 12/18 in the muted token, sentence-case 12px label (.eyebrow), content caps .page.form-page 1280 and .page.table-page 1600; the page-title to first-section gap equals the section gap (the page is one flex column).
